Delhi PG Owner Arrested After Building Collapse Kills Seven

Hariram Gupta, the owner of a paying guest accommodation in Delhi's Satya Niketan area, has been arrested in Rajasthan following a building collapse that killed seven people. Gupta, described as a retired Indian Air Force veteran, was reportedly on the run before his apprehension. The collapse occurred at a PG facility he owned. Authorities have taken him into custody in connection with the incident.
